logic_node.action_detail: In select patients with advanced HFrEF with NYHA class IV symptoms who are deemed dependent on continuous intravenous inotropes or temporary MCS, durable LVAD implantation is effective to improve functional status, QOL, and survival.

source_text: In select patients with advanced HFrEF with NYHA class IV symptoms who are deemed to be dependent on continuous intravenous inotropes or temporary MCS, durable LVAD implantation is effective to improve functional status, QOL, and survival.

logic_node.action_detail: In select patients with advanced HFrEF who have NYHA class IV symptoms despite GDMT, durable MCS can be beneficial to improve symptoms, improve functional class, and reduce mortality.

source_text: In select patients with advanced HFrEF who have NYHA class IV symptoms despite GDMT, durable MCS can be beneficial to improve symptoms, improve functional class, and reduce mortality.

logic_node.action: Assess economic value of durable MCS
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with advanced HFrEF who have NYHA class IV symptoms despite GDMT, durable MCS devices provide low to intermediate economic value based on current costs and outcomes. Value Statement: Uncertain Value.

source_text: In patients with advanced HFrEF who have NYHA class IV symptoms despite GDMT, durable MCS devices provide low to intermediate economic value based on current costs and outcomes.

logic_node.action: Use temporary MCS as bridge to recovery or decision
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with advanced HFrEF and hemodynamic compromise and shock, temporary MCS, including percutaneous and extracorporeal ventricular assist devices, are reasonable as a bridge to recovery or bridge to decision.

source_text: In patients with advanced HFrEF and hemodynamic compromise and shock, temporary MCS, including percutaneous and extracorporeal ventricular assist devices, are reasonable as a 'bridge to recovery' or 'bridge to decision.'

logic_node.action_detail: 87.6% of recent durable LVAD recipients were categorized as INTERMACS 1 to 3 before implant surgery. Patients with INTERMACS profile 1 have poorer outcomes; ambulatory patients with profiles 5-7 might be too well for significant benefit. 2-year survival >80% with newer generation LVADs.

source_text: The 2020 INTERMACS report showed that 87.6% of recent durable LVAD recipients were categorized as INTERMACS 1 to 3 before their implant surgery. It also showed improved mean survival, >4 years for the destination LVAD cohort.

logic_node.action_detail: For selected patients with advanced HF despite GDMT, cardiac transplantation is indicated to improve survival and QOL. Median survival of adult transplant recipients is now >12 years.

source_text: For selected patients with advanced HF despite GDMT, cardiac transplantation is indicated to improve survival and QOL.

logic_node.action: Assess economic value of cardiac transplantation
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with stage D (advanced) HF despite GDMT, cardiac transplantation provides intermediate economic value. Value Statement: Intermediate Value.

source_text: In patients with stage D (advanced) HF despite GDMT, cardiac transplantation provides intermediate economic value.

logic_node.action: Continue and uptitrate GDMT after MCS implantation
logic_node.action_detail: Continuing and uptitrating guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) in patients with durable MCS is recommended.

source_text: Continuing and uptitrating GDMT in patients with durable MCS is recommended.

logic_node.action: Caution with durable MCS if unable to tolerate anticoagulation
logic_node.action_detail: In patients who are unable to tolerate anticoagulation after repeated challenges, implantation of a durable MCS is associated with excess morbidity. Pump thrombosis, hemolysis, and ischemic neurologic events have been linked to subtherapeutic INR.

source_text: In patients who are unable to tolerate anticoagulation after repeated challenges, implantation of a durable MCS is associated with excess morbidity; incidents of pump thrombosis, hemolysis, and ischemic neurologic events have been linked to subtherapeutic INR.

logic_node.action: Use MCS to bridge transplant-ineligible patients
logic_node.action_detail: For patients initially considered transplant ineligible because of pulmonary hypertension, obesity, overall frailty, or other reasons, MCS can provide time to reverse or modify these conditions.

source_text: For patients who are initially considered to be transplant ineligible because of pulmonary hypertension, obesity, overall frailty, or other reasons, MCS can provide time to reverse or modify these conditions.

logic_node.action: Use CPET to refine transplant candidate selection
logic_node.action_detail: Cardiopulmonary exercise testing (CPET) can refine candidate prognosis and selection for cardiac transplantation. Appropriate patient selection should include integration of comorbidity burden, caretaker status, and goals of care.

source_text: CPET can refine candidate prognosis and selection. Appropriate patient selection should include integration of comorbidity burden, caretaker status, and goals of care.
